data.title: A paragraph beside the window

memoryNodes.cue: Each activity has a bullet point.

data.situation:
At the window desk, Jo was drafting an article from the interview. The first paragraph put the changed opening times before the story of the repairs. She added a bullet point for each activity that was still running, then read the content from beginning to end. The details were all there, but the article was not yet coherent: one sentence sent readers to the old entrance, while the next directed them to the side gate. Nora placed the latest map beside the draft. Jo corrected the route and removed a sentence that repeated the date. Through the open window came the sound of someone dragging a chair downstairs. The people in the article were already getting ready for the evening class. Jo: The dates are accurate, but the route is confusing.
Nora: Read that paragraph as if you had never visited.
Jo: I will put the side gate first and use bullet points for the activities.

readingBlocks.zh: 窗边的书桌上，乔根据采访起草文章。第一段先写调整后的开放时间，再讲维修。每项仍举行的活动都有一个项目符号条目。她从头到尾读了内容：细节齐全，却还不连贯。一句话让读者去旧入口，下一句又引导他们去侧门。诺拉把最新地图放在初稿旁。乔改正路线，删去一句重复日期的话。窗外传来楼下拖动椅子的声音，文章里的人已经在准备晚间课程了。

readingBlocks.zh:
乔：日期准确，但路线让人困惑。
诺拉：假设你从未到过这里，再读那段话。
乔：我先写侧门，用项目符号列活动。

glossary.zh: 撰写初步版本的过程；起草
glossary.note: drafting 是起草过程；a draft 是一份初稿。
glossary.example: Drafting the article took the morning.
glossary.exampleZh: 起草文章用了一个上午。

externalEvidence.definition: writing a first version to be filled out and polished later

glossary.zh: 报刊等发表的一篇文章
glossary.example: Jo wrote an article about the hall.
glossary.exampleZh: 乔写了一篇关于大厅的文章。

externalEvidence.definition: nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication

glossary.zh: 文章中表达一组相关内容的段落
glossary.note: a paragraph；通常用缩进或空行分段。
glossary.example: The first paragraph gave the new times.

externalEvidence.definition: one of several distinct subdivisions of a text intended to separate ideas; the beginning is usually marked by a new indented line

glossary.zh: 用项目符号标出的条目
glossary.note: a bullet 是标记，bullet point 常指被标出的条目。
glossary.example: Each activity had a separate bullet point.
glossary.exampleZh: 每项活动有独立的项目符号条目。

externalEvidence.label: Collins English Dictionary
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: COBUILD noun item sense; British and American item definitions

glossary.zh: 文章或节目包含的信息和想法
glossary.note: 这里是内容名词，通常不可数；注意与满意的 content 区分。
glossary.example: The content matched the latest timetable.
glossary.exampleZh: 内容与最新时间表一致。

externalEvidence.definition: what a communication that is about something is about

glossary.zh: 内容有条理、彼此连贯的
glossary.note: a coherent account；相应名词 coherence。
glossary.exampleZh: 修改后的文章有条理且连贯。

externalEvidence.definition: marked by an orderly, logical, and aesthetically consistent relation of parts
